description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Steelclash

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after performing Heavy Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack after a successful Mid-air Dodge to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep

When Prowess is full, Heavy Attack - Steelclash is replaced with Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
- While in action, release or press Normal Attack again within a certain period to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash

Augusta whirls and lashes out with her Broadblade, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut

Press Jump when Prowess is full to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, press Resonance Skill or Jump to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting Heavy Attack - Steelclash or Dodge Counter – Heavy Attack: Steelclash, release Normal Attack after a certain period or press Normal Attack or Jump again to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing, Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.

Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash

When Prowess is full, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep

When Ascendancy is full, press Normal Attack following a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep in place of Dodge Counter and Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Release or press Normal Attack again within a certain period into the action to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

Prowess

Augusta can hold up to 100 points of Prowess.
- Prowess is obtained when Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Steelclash, Mid-air Attack, Mid-air Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, Dodge Counter, or Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash deals damage.
- Prowess is fully restored when casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Steelclash

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG. Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melakukan Heavy Attack untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dari udara, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack setelah Mid-air Dodge berhasil untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dengan biaya STA, memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep

Saat Prowess penuh, Heavy Attack - Steelclash digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep, memberikan Electro DMG dan mengonsumsi seluruh Prowess.
- Saat gerakan berlangsung, lepas atau tekan Normal Attack lagi dalam jangka waktu tertentu untuk melakukan Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash tersedia jika Augusta tetap berada di tanah selama jangka waktu tertentu setelah skill ini terinterupsi.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash

Augusta berputar dan menghantamkan Broadblade miliknya, memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut

Tekan Jump saat Prowess penuh untuk melakukan Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, memberikan Electro DMG dan mengonsumsi seluruh Prowess.
Jika Prowess penuh saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, tekan Resonance Skill atau Jump untuk melakukan Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, memberikan Electro DMG dan mengonsumsi seluruh Prowess.
Jika Prowess penuh saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Steelclash atau Dodge Counter – Heavy Attack: Steelclash, lepas Normal Attack setelah jangka waktu tertentu atau tekan Normal Attack atau Jump lagi untuk melakukan Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, memberikan Electro DMG dan mengonsumsi seluruh Prowess.

Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash

Saat Prowess penuh, Dodge Counter digantikan oleh Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep

Saat Ascendancy penuh, tekan Normal Attack setelah Dodge di darat berhasil untuk melancarkan Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep sebagai pengganti Dodge Counter dan Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
- Lepas atau tekan Normal Attack lagi dalam jangka waktu tertentu saat gerakan berlangsung untuk melakukan Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash tersedia jika Augusta tetap berada di tanah selama jangka waktu tertentu setelah skill ini terinterupsi.

Prowess

Augusta dapat menampung hingga 100 poin Prowess.
- Prowess didapat saat Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Steelclash, Mid-air Attack, Mid-air Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, Dodge Counter, atau Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash memberikan damage.
- Prowess pulih sepenuhnya saat melancarkan Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare.

description.en: Augusta leaps and slams down her Broadblade, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id: Augusta melompat dan menghantamkan Broadblade miliknya, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en:
Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath

Press and release Resonance Liberation to cast this skill. Augusta will sweep her Broadblade forward, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun

When Majesty reaches 2 stacks, hold Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun. Casting Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun costs no Resonance Energy but 2 stacks of Majesty instead.
- When casting Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun, Augusta generates the Ruler's Realm and enters the Sworn Allegiance state for 7s. Within this duration, time is temporarily stopped, and Resonator switching is disabled. Only Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector, and Dodge can be performed in the Sworn Allegiance state. Mid-air Attack is available while airborne.
- In the Sworn Allegiance state, press or hold Normal Attack to cast Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne. Augusta can walk on water without consuming STA in this state.
- Performing environmental, gameplay, or other interactions ends Sworn Allegiance without triggering Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector.

Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne

Deal Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. After casting Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne 9 times, press Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to perform Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector.

Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector

Deal Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector ends the Sworn Allegiance state and consumes all stacks of Crown of Wills later. All other Resonators in the team will be made to leave the field.
- When Sworn Allegiance ends, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector is automatically cast.
- During Sworn Allegiance, hold Resonance Liberation to cast Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector early.

Ruler's Realm

- Ruler's Realm lasts for 30s.
- When Resonators in the team cast Intro Skill within Ruler's Realm, they gain a shield equal to 650 + 5% of Augusta's Max HP for 10s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

Majesty

Augusta can hold up to 2 stacks of Majesty.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when casting Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when other Resonators in the team cast Outro Skill under the effect of Augusta's Outro Skill - Battlesong of the Unyielding.
description.id:
Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath

Tekan dan lepas Resonance Liberation untuk melancarkan skill ini. Augusta menyapukan Broadblade miliknya ke depan, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun

Saat Majesty mencapai 2 stack, tahan Resonance Liberation untuk melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun. Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun tidak membutuhkan Resonance Energy, melainkan mengonsumsi 2 stack Majesty.
- Saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun, Augusta menciptakan Ruler's Realm dan memasuki status Sworn Allegiance selama 7 dtk. Selama durasi ini, waktu terhenti sementara dan pergantian Resonator dinonaktifkan. Hanya Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector, dan Dodge yang dapat dilakukan dalam status Sworn Allegiance. Mid-air Attack tersedia saat berada di udara.
- Dalam status Sworn Allegiance, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne. Augusta dapat berjalan di atas air tanpa mengonsumsi STA dalam status ini.
- Melakukan interaksi lingkungan, gameplay, atau interaksi lainnya mengakhiri Sworn Allegiance tanpa memicu Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector.

Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne

Memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG. Setelah melancarkan Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne sebanyak 9 kali, tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Liberation untuk melakukan Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector.

Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector

Memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG. Melancarkan Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector mengakhiri status Sworn Allegiance dan kemudian mengonsumsi seluruh stack Crown of Wills. Semua Resonator lain di tim akan dikeluarkan dari arena.
- Saat Sworn Allegiance berakhir, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector otomatis dilancarkan.
- Selama Sworn Allegiance, tahan Resonance Liberation untuk melancarkan Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector lebih awal.

Ruler's Realm

- Ruler's Realm berlangsung selama 30 dtk.
- Saat Resonator di tim melancarkan Intro Skill di dalam Ruler's Realm, mereka mendapat Shield sebesar 650 + 5% Max HP Augusta selama 10 dtk. Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk. Shield ini tidak diteruskan ke Resonator yang masuk.

Majesty

Augusta dapat menampung hingga 2 stack Majesty.
- 1 stack Majesty didapat saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- 1 stack Majesty didapat saat Resonator lain di tim melancarkan Outro Skill di bawah efek Outro Skill Augusta - Battlesong of the Unyielding.

description.en: When Augusta deals damage, she gains a shield equal to 350 + 2.5% of her Max HP for 5s, triggered once every 0.5s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
description.id: Saat Augusta memberikan damage, ia mendapat Shield sebesar 350 + 2,5% Max HP-nya selama 5 dtk, dipicu sekali setiap 0,5 dtk. Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk. Shield ini tidak diteruskan ke Resonator yang masuk.

description.en:
When Augusta is out of combat for over 4s, she gains the following effects that can be triggered once every 4s:
- If Majesty is less than 1 stack, restore 1 stack.
- Fully restore Crown of Wills.
description.id:
Saat Augusta berada di luar pertarungan selama lebih dari 4 dtk, ia mendapat efek berikut yang dapat dipicu sekali setiap 4 dtk:
- Jika Majesty kurang dari 1 stack, pulihkan 1 stack.
- Memulihkan Crown of Wills sepenuhnya.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike

When Ascendancy is full, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade is replaced with Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
- Press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be cast some time again after being interrupted.
- Can be cast mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap

Deal Electro DMG.
- Press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge can be cast some time again after being interrupted.
- Can only be cast mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge

Consume all Ascendancy to cast this skill, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill grants 1 stack of Majesty.
- Can only be cast mid-air.

Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike

When Ascendancy is full, press Resonance Skill after a successful ground Dodge or press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill after successful Mid-air Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
- Press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be cast again some time after being interrupted.

Ascendancy

Augusta can hold up to 100 points of Ascendancy.
- Ascendancy is obtained when Normal Attacks deal damage.
- Casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare restores 20% Ascendancy.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade restores 10% Ascendancy.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath restores 40% Ascendancy.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike

Saat Ascendancy penuh, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade digantikan oleh Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike, memberikan Electro DMG.
- Tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill saat gerakan berlangsung untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike dapat dilancarkan ulang sesaat setelah terinterupsi.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap dapat dilancarkan lagi beberapa saat setelah terinterupsi.
- Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap

Memberikan Electro DMG.
- Tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill saat gerakan berlangsung untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap dapat dilancarkan ulang sesaat setelah terinterupsi.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge dapat dilancarkan lagi beberapa saat setelah terinterupsi.
- Hanya dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge

Mengonsumsi seluruh Ascendancy untuk melancarkan skill ini, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
- Melancarkan skill ini memberikan 1 stack Majesty.
- Hanya dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike

Saat Ascendancy penuh, tekan Resonance Skill setelah Dodge di darat berhasil atau tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill setelah Mid-air Dodge berhasil untuk melancarkan Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
- Tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill saat gerakan berlangsung untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap dapat dilancarkan lagi beberapa saat setelah terinterupsi.

Ascendancy

Augusta dapat menampung hingga 100 poin Ascendancy.
- Ascendancy didapat saat Normal Attack memberikan damage.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare memulihkan 20% Ascendancy.
- Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade memulihkan 10% Ascendancy.
- Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath memulihkan 40% Ascendancy.

description.en:
The next Resonator switched onto the field gains the following effects for 14s, which end immediately if they are switched out:
- Gain 15% DMG Amplification for all Attributes.
- Casting Outro Skill grants 1 stacks of Majesty and 1 stacks of Crown of Wills to Augusta.

Crown of Wills

Each stack grants 15% Electro DMG Bonus, up to 1 stack. When Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Everbright Protector ends, all stacks of Crown of Wills are removed.
description.id:
Resonator berikutnya yang masuk ke arena mendapat efek berikut selama 14 dtk, yang langsung berakhir jika ia diganti keluar:
- Mendapat 15% DMG Amplification untuk semua Attribute.
- Melancarkan Outro Skill memberikan 1 stack Majesty dan 1 stack Crown of Wills kepada Augusta.

Crown of Wills

Setiap stack memberikan 15% Electro DMG Bonus, hingga 1 stack. Saat Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Everbright Protector berakhir, seluruh stack Crown of Wills dihapus.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
- Each stack of Crown of Wills additionally increases Augusta's Crit. DMG by 15%.
- The max stack of Crown of Wills is increased to 2.
- Casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare now grants 1 stacks of Crown of Wills.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike, Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap, and Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge are now immune to interruption.
description.id:
- Setiap stack Crown of Wills juga meningkatkan Crit. DMG Augusta sebesar 15%.
- Stack maksimum Crown of Wills meningkat menjadi 2.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare kini memberikan 1 stack Crown of Wills.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike, Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap, dan Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge kini kebal terhadap interupsi.

description.en:
- Crown of Wills provides additional effects: Each stack increases Augusta's Crit. Rate by 20%.
- For every 1% of Crit. Rate over 100%, Augusta gains 2% Crit. DMG increase, up to 100%.
description.id:
- Crown of Wills memberikan efek tambahan: Setiap stack meningkatkan Crit. Rate Augusta sebesar 20%.
- Untuk setiap 1% Crit. Rate di atas 100%, Augusta mendapat peningkatan Crit. DMG sebesar 2%, hingga 100%.

description.en:
The following skills have their DMG Multiplier increased by 25%:
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep, Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep, Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash, Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Sunborne, Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Everbright Protector.
description.id:
Pengali DMG skill berikut meningkat sebesar 25%:
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep, Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep, Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash, Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Sunborne, Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Everbright Protector.

description.en: Casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.
description.id: Melancarkan Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare meningkatkan ATK seluruh Resonator di tim sebesar 20% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: The Shield provided by Inherent Skill - Glory's Favor is increased by 50%.
description.id: Shield yang diberikan oleh Inherent Skill - Glory's Favor meningkat sebesar 50%.

description.en:
- Augusta can now hold up to 4 stacks of Crown of Wills.
- For every 1% of Crit. Rate over 150%, Augusta gains 2% Crit. DMG increase, up to 50%.
- When Augusta performs Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash or Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, she obtains 2 stack of Crown of Wills. Augusta can only obtain 2 stacks of Crown of Wills every 1s via Engraved in Radiant Light.
- While casting Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash or Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, Thunder Rage is triggered at the spot, dealing two instances of Electro DMG, with each instance equal to 100% of Augusta's ATK, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
description.id:
- Augusta kini dapat menampung hingga 4 stack Crown of Wills.
- Untuk setiap 1% Crit. Rate di atas 150%, Augusta mendapat peningkatan Crit. DMG sebesar 2%, hingga 50%.
- Saat Augusta melakukan Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash atau Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, ia mendapat 2 stack Crown of Wills. Augusta hanya dapat memperoleh 2 stack Crown of Wills setiap 1 dtk melalui Engraved in Radiant Light.
- Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash atau Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, Thunder Rage dipicu di lokasi tersebut, memberikan dua instance Electro DMG, masing-masing sebesar 100% ATK Augusta, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
